description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of child nodes (tree width) and the accuracy of GPT-4o, as measured by the percentage of correct answers. The x-axis is labeled "Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)" and is a linear scale ranging from 1 to 7. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)" and is also a linear scale ranging from 15 to 35. The plot features a single line representing GPT-4o, which is marked with blue circles at each data point. The line starts at a value of 24.4% accuracy with 1 child node, increases to 26.7% with 2 child nodes, then to 28.9% with 3 child nodes, peaks at 34.4% with 5 child nodes, and finally decreases to 31.1% with 7 child nodes. The line is solid, indicating a continuous trend without breaks or gaps.
